minutes_text:
GLENDALE PLANNING HEARING OFFICER
GLENDALE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT
  PUBLIC HEARING MINUTES
  FEBRUARY 26, 2020
9:30 a.m.  Mr. Roger Kiesel, Planning Hearing Officer, opened the hearing in
  Room 105 of the Municipal Services Building. He outlined the
  requirements of Title 30 for the pertinent cases and described the
  provisions for appeal in Title 30 of the Glendale Municipal Code as
  well as the procedures for the conduct of the hearings.

  Mr. Kiesel announced that the agenda for the meeting was posted
  on February 19, 2020, at the City Hall Entrance.

Staff Members Present – Community Development Department
1) Roger Kiesel, Planning Hearing Officer
2) Brad Collin, Senior Planner

(1) LOCATION: 744 SOUTH GLENDALE AVENUE
   PARKING REDUCTION CASE NO. PPRP 1809672
  (CONTINUED FROM FEBRUARY 5, 2020)
APPLICANT:  Rodney V Khan – Khan Consulting Inc.
ZONE:  “C3” - Commercial Service Zone
LEGAL DESCRIPTION: The north half of lot 16 and the south half of Lot 17,
  and Lots 14 and 15, Glendale Garden Home Tract

PROJECT DESCRIPTION
Application for a Parking Reduction Permit to allow a change in use from a day
care center to a fast food restaurant without providing the required number of
parking spaces for the change in use.
CODE REQUIRES
Parking Reduction Permit
(1) A parking reduction permit is required when a use cannot provide the necessary
  parking on-site. As proposed, 31 additional parking spaces are required for the
  change in use from a day care center to a fast food restaurant.
APPLICANT’S PROPOSAL
Parking Reduction Permit
(1) To allow a two fast food restaurant to operate as one in the existing building
  without providing the required 31 additional on-site parking spaces.
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  2
February 26, 2020

ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 1 “Existing Facilities”
exemption pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 because this a
change in use from a day care center to a fast food restaurant without providing
the required parking spaces within an existing building.

Staff
- Mr. Brad Collin, case planner, overviewed the staff report. He answered questions
from the Planning Hearing Officer.

Applicants
 - Mr. Rodney Khan, consultant on the project, and representing the applicant and
the owner, presented the case.
- Mr. Jano Baghdanian, traffic consultant on the project, explained the flow of traffic
and parking.

WRITTEN PUBLIC INPUT
In Favor:  None
Interested Party: None.
In Opposition:  None.

SPEAKING AT THE HEARING

In Favor:  No one.
In Opposition:  No one.
Interested Party:  No one.

The case was taken under submission for a decision to be made at a later date.

(2) LOCATION:  744 SOUTH GLENDALE AVENUE - UNIT #1
   PARKING REDUCTION CASE NO. PPRP 1621936
  (CONTINUED FROM FEBRUARY 5, 2020)

APPLICANT:  Nareg Khodadadi
ZONE:  “C3” - Commercial Service Zone
LEGAL DESCRIPTION:  The north half of lot 16 and the south half of
  Lot 17, and Lots 14 and 15, Glendale Garden Home Tract
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  3
February 26, 2020

PROJECT DESCRIPTION
Application for a Parking Reduction Permit to allow a change in use from a day
care center to a children's indoor play area without providing the required
parking, in a “C3” - (Commercial Service) Zone.
CODE REQUIRES
Parking Reduction Permit
(1) A parking reduction permit is required when a use cannot provide the
  necessary parking on-site. As proposed, 19 additional parking spaces are
  required for the change in use from a day care center to a children’s indoor
  play area.
APPLICANT’S PROPOSAL
Parking Reduction Permit
(1) To allow an indoor children’s play area in the existing building without
  providing the required 19 additional on-site parking spaces.

ENVIRONMENTAL DETERMINATION
The project is exempt from CEQA review as a Class 1 “Existing Facilities” exemption
pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines Section 15301 due to a change in use from a day
care center to a children’s indoor play area without providing the required parking
spaces within an existing building.

Staff
- Mr. Brad Collin, case planner, overviewed the staff report. He answered questions
from the Planning Hearing Officer.

APPLICANTS
- Mr. Rodney Khan, consultant on the project, and representing the applicant and
the owner, presented the case.
- Mr. Jano Baghdanian, traffic technician on the project, explained the flow of traffic
and parking.

WRITTEN PUBLIC INPUT
In Favor:  None
Interested Party: None.
In Opposition:  None.
 Planning Hearing Officer Minutes  4
February 26, 2020

SPEAKING AT THE HEARING
In Favor:  No one.
In Opposition:  No one.
Interested Party: No one.

The case was taken under submission with a decision to be made at a later date.

The meeting adjourned at 11:00 a.m.
